correctness.rationale: In a perfect evolution algebra the squares of natural basis vectors are a basis, so automorphisms monomial. Full-support nonzero diagonal forces trivial identity-permutation scalar kernel. For prescribed tau, compatibility scalars t,t^-1 and fixed other scalars give (q-1)^(n²-2n+3) matrices, probability (q-1)^(3-2n) before conditioning. Determinant polynomial is nonzero on torus and each transposition stratum (witness I+uJ), yielding relative O_n(q^-1) loss from conditioning on nonsingular matrices. Other permutations moving k>=3 have orbit deficit >=nk-k²/2, and union bound with permutation product controls overlapping swaps and gives event O_n((q-1)^(-(2n-2))) or O_n((q-1)^(-(2n-1))) for n>=6. Dividing by leading rare probability proves C2 with stated errors. Checked exact F3 n3 prescribed swap count, orbit deficits in n5,6 and matrix rank. All asymptotics require fixed n not dimension-growing.
